capture_policy: EPUB capture host lays out continuously but paints only while obtaining a texture
limitations: Profile mode, one Android phone; no new iOS/tablet/desktop real-book validation.
Input metrics end at raster completion, not display presentation.
120 Hz budget exceedance measures pipeline duration, not dropped frames.

Repeated runs vary across formats. The final run has 13.1% over the 120 Hz budget in CBZ single-page; earlier references have substantial EPUB double-page exceedance. No stable 120 Hz or thermal/shader root cause established.
Source open plus texture preparation excludes Flutter startup and APK launch. Warm animation excludes parsing, decoding and EPUB pagination.
32 MiB is the RGBA texture-cache budget, not total application memory. Native PDF, parser, images and GPU allocations are extra.
Texture quality is capped at 1,000,000 pixels per page; not full panel-resolution content.
Reference measurements used a continuously painted EPUB host. Final measurements park that host between captures.
No book files, titles, full content, absolute source paths or screenshots are included.
Not integrated into the production reader; no Apple Books visual equivalence claim.
